By earning Honorary Ambassador or Early Bird status, you automatically join the Priority Waitlist. You signal your readiness to be among the first to join our family at official launch. Your engagement is the energy that drives the project forward.

aylopetAi.title: AylopetAI
aylopetAi.lead: AylopetAI is your dog's personal digital nutritionist. It is a specialized artificial intelligence whose knowledge is focused exclusively on canine nutrition. Developed by international-level professional nutritionists, the system allows you to receive a scientifically-backed, individual feeding plan and advice in just 60 seconds. AylopetAI is available 24/7 to safeguard your friend's health.

smartCollar.title: Aylopet Pro
smartCollar.lead: Aylopet Pro is a smart collar designed for real-time dog monitoring, ensuring both safety and activity tracking. The device precisely measures location and distance traveled, allowing us to calculate actual energy expenditure. Based on the data from Aylopet Pro, our AI determines the exact caloric requirements, ensuring your four-legged friend receives exactly what they truly need.

pasteurizedRaw.title: Fresh Dog Food: The Evolution of Canine Nutrition
pasteurizedRaw.intro: Discover the power of gently cooked meals and the truth that kibble manufacturers won't tell you.
pasteurizedRaw.p1: We believe true vitality comes only from natural, minimally processed Fresh Food. Aylopet's ration, prepared with a Gently Cooked method, is an evolutionary bridge between wild instinct and modern safety. We created a formula where your four-legged friend no longer has to choose between Fresh Dog Food and safety.
pasteurizedRaw.p2: With our low-temperature pasteurization (70-75°C), we fully eliminate harmful pathogens while preserving the vital enzymes, nutrients, and amino acids found only in raw meat. These are exactly the components that are instantly destroyed during high-heat processing (boiling or baking at 200°C).
pasteurizedRaw.p3: We do not produce generic dog food; we transform our product into safe Fresh Dog Food. As a result, your companion receives a biologically active diet without artificial additives, synthetic preservatives, hidden sugars, or flavor enhancers. We offer what kibble manufacturers won't tell you: real meat instead of synthetic vitamin dependency.
pasteurizedRaw.videoTitle: See the Evolution of Nutrition in Action:
pasteurizedRaw.videoSubtitle: Learn how we create safe, Fresh Dog Food for your companion.

whyHealthy.title: Why Is Fresh Food Critical?
whyHealthy.intro: Aylopet's philosophy is simple and science-based: balanced Fresh Food (comparable in quality to the best home-prepared diets) is directly linked to a longer, more energetic life. We do not just make food; we build an individualized, evidence-based diet tailored to your dog's unique biological needs.
whyHealthy.evidenceLead: The benefits of Fresh Food are not just theory; they are supported by international research:
whyHealthy.study1Body: A large 2003 study (Lippert & Sapy) based on data from 537 dogs found that dogs fed natural, minimally processed food lived an average of 32 months (almost 3 years) longer than dogs fed industrially processed dry food.
whyHealthy.study2Body: Research from The Farmer's Dog and independent investigators indicates that nutrition based on natural ingredients improves hydration, supports healthier digestion, strengthens immune response, and helps maintain more stable energy levels.
whyHealthy.outro: Aylopet's goal is to bring these scientific advances into your daily routine. With our personalized plan, your companion gets the chance to live not only longer, but better, full of energy and vitality.
